visual_review.notes: Reviewed on H3 video. Attack v1 and death v1 are clean. Idle v1 lost five single frames to plate pulses; the loop steps over them without a visible pop. Defend v1 lost the crouch to plate pulses, and defend v2 and v3 snapped from the stance into the guard in one frame; defend v4, guided only by its final guard pose and asked for a steady crouch over a second, lowers smoothly from video 28 to 40 and is used. Hit, cast, ranged and walk keep their published H3 clips.
